therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: patients with coronary arteriosclerosis or acute coronary syndrome already on clopidogrel therapy
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Maximum Platelet Aggregation (MPA) to 20 uM ADP at 1 week after first dose of randomized study drug

results.effect_size: Mean difference -13.91% (95% CI: -19.10 to -8.73) for prasugrel vs clopidogrel
results.target_engagement_evidence: Reduced maximum platelet aggregation (MPA) to 20 uM ADP measured by light transmittance aggregometry (LTA); VerifyNow P2Y12 assay correlated with LTA (r=0.426–0.640)
biomarker_changes: MPA to 20 uM ADP at 1 week: Prasugrel 10/10 mg 41.1%, Clopidogrel 75/75 mg 55.0%, Prasugrel 60/10 mg 41.0%
RPA to 20 uM ADP at 1 week: Prasugrel 10/10 mg 22.92%, Clopidogrel 75/75 mg 34.45%, Prasugrel 60/10 mg 17.94%
Prasugrel 60/10 mg showed greatest early platelet inhibition at 2 hours (MPA 26.65%) and 24 hours (MPA 27.36%) vs clopidogrel
VerifyNow P2Y12 correlation coefficients with MPA at 1 week: 0.564 (prasugrel 10/10), 0.426 (clopidogrel), 0.439 (prasugrel 60/10)
VerifyNow P2Y12 correlation coefficients with RPA at 1 week: 0.640 (prasugrel 10/10), 0.425 (clopidogrel), 0.547 (prasugrel 60/10)
subgroup_findings: At 2 hours, prasugrel 60/10 mg showed significantly lower MPA vs clopidogrel (26.65% vs 48.07%, LS mean diff -23, p<0.0001), while prasugrel 10/10 mg was not significantly different from clopidogrel (49.46% vs 48.07%, p=0.4055)

At 24 hours, prasugrel 60/10 mg showed significantly lower MPA vs clopidogrel (27.36% vs 53.80%, LS mean diff -29, p<0.0001), while prasugrel 10/10 mg was not significantly different (52.29% vs 53.80%, p=0.0680)
At 1 week and 2 weeks, both prasugrel regimens showed significantly lower MPA vs clopidogrel (p<0.0001)
MPA to 20 uM ADP at end of open-label phase: clopidogrel use at ACS event 60.73% vs no clopidogrel use 55.53% (p=0.1824, not significant)
safety_signals: Bleeding events were mostly insignificant by TIMI criteria; no major or minor bleeding events observed during randomized period
Any bleeding during randomized period: prasugrel 10/10 mg 4 participants, clopidogrel 75/75 mg 6 participants, prasugrel 60/10 mg 6 participants
Serious adverse events reported only in prasugrel 10/10 mg arm: chest pain (1/47), in-stent coronary artery restenosis (1/47), syncope (1/47)

dose_info.dose: prasugrel 10 mg maintenance (with or without 60 mg loading dose); clopidogrel 75 mg

context.duration: 14-day open-label phase followed by randomized treatment period up to 2 weeks
